entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker hostage to Bolas who fled Ravnica after his defeat and is hunted as a traitor.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: The Gatewatch's newest member, a hunter and assassin tasked by the guildmasters with tracking down Liliana.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Champion of justice and shield of the Gatewatch who died in Liliana's place.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Former Gatewatch comrade struggling to rebuild after Gideon's death.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Former Gatewatch comrade struggling to rebuild after Gideon's death.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon defeated by the Planeswalkers.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group of planeswalkers whose future is uncertain after Gideon's death.

entities.name: Ravnica guildmasters
entities.description: Grieving leaders who tasked Kaya with a secret mission.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: War in whose aftermath the hunt for Liliana takes place.

events.summary: Planeswalkers defeat Nicol Bolas and save the Multiverse at grave cost; Gideon is lost.
events.quote: Gideon Jura , champion of justice and shield of the Gatewatch , is gone.

events.summary: Kaya joins the Gatewatch and pledges an oath to protect the living and the dead.
events.quote: As the Gatewatch's newest member, Kaya aims to help write that future.

events.summary: The guildmasters task Kaya with tracking down and exacting retribution on Liliana, in secret from the Gatewatch.
events.quote: She must track down and exact retribution on the traitor Liliana Vess.

events.summary: Gideon dies in Liliana's place after she was forced to assist Bolas; she flees Ravnica.
events.quote: until Gideon, the last one who believed in her goodness, died in her place

events.summary: Liliana returns home, the only place she has left.
events.quote: Liliana now returns to a place she'd thought she'd never see again

relations.quote: As the Gatewatch's newest member, Kaya aims to help write that future.
The grieving guildmasters of Ravnica have tasked her with a grave mission
She must track down and exact retribution on the traitor Liliana Vess.

relations.note: hostage forced to assist his atrocities
relations.quote: forced to assist in his terrible atrocities on pain of death
